about: Tokens each agent's own session has used, by the WS-148 method: an agent runs tools/accounts-measure.mjs in its own session and commits one line of numbers to accounts/ledger/<role>.jsonl (fresh input, output, cache writes, cache reads; no message text). Only the agent can measure its session. Where no line exists the cell says "not measured". Tokens, not money: no price is applied.

method.counted: each API message once, by its id; a line is the session's running total and the latest line of each session counts

weighted.formula: fresh input + output + cache writes + cache reads x 0.1
weighted.source: WS-148 PROMPT.md: cache reads cost about a tenth of fresh input; a relative weight to compare sessions, not a price

coverage.source: agents/policy.json and data/agents/sessions.json for who exists; accounts/ledger/ for who has measured

team_measured.note: the sum of the 30 measured of 41 agents; not the team's total

per_commit.kind: measured tokens over commits counted by incident.ci@ (the two were read at different times)
